column1: # MagiTranslator Japanese -> Nepali dictionary (jane Glossary). Not in the APK: published to the
# release "jane-dictionaries" and downloaded / imported by the app (DictionaryStore). Keep the first line.
# Format: japanese<TAB>nepali, one entry per line; lines starting with # are comments.
# Every entry is injected into the Japanese input and becomes a REQUIRED term of the translation
# (TranslationValidator TERM_MISSING is a hard error), so only add words that:
#  - have one established Nepali equivalent (no guesses, no rare synonyms);
#  - are nouns written the same way in every sentence (no verbs, no inflecting words);
#  - are at least 2 characters and not ambiguous as a substring (時間 is also a duration counter,
#    先生 is also an honorific, 休み is also a verb stem -> not listed);
#  - when a real compound contains another entry, list the compound too (東京都 so that 京都 is not
#    replaced inside it; 小学校, 会社員, 保険証 ...). Longer keys are replaced first.
# JaNeLibraryTest checks the format, duplicates and these compounds.
# Entries are reviewed by hand; a native Nepali speaker should confirm new ones before they are added.
# ---- everyday: family (Nepali distinguishes older / younger siblings)
# ---- care (介護). Nepali chosen from news usage (2026-11 crawl, dictionaries/sources/care_crawl_2026-11.md):
# Nepali news writes the job as the loanword केयरगिभर; uncertain terms are in dictionaries/review/, not here.
# ---- medical: illnesses and symptoms (from Wikidata, CC0, each pair checked by hand;
# ---- medical: body (from Wikidata, checked by hand; only words of 2+ characters).
# 神経 is not listed: it would be replaced inside 神経質 (nervous temperament).
# ---- care work (介護福祉職): terms of the MHLW question standard for the care skills test
# (出典: 厚生労働省ホームページ, 介護知識・技能に関する出題基準, PDL1.0; edited) and the national care
# worker exam (frequency only). Disability categories follow Nepal's official ones.
